key_decisions.rationale: Keeps encouragement, love's joining work and Christ as the mystery's apposition.
key_decisions.before: so that their hearts may be encouraged, joined together in love, and brought into all the riches of full assurance that comes from understanding, to know God’s mystery, Christ,
key_decisions.after: so that their hearts may be encouraged, joined together in love, and reach all the riches of full assurance in understanding: the knowledge of God's mystery, Christ,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: that their hearts may be encouraged, being knit together in love, and into all the riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the knowledge of the mystery of God, which is Christ,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the captive image, human tradition and the difficult elemental-powers expression.
key_decisions.before: Watch out that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception, according to human tradition, according to the elemental powers of the world, and not according to Christ.
key_decisions.after: Watch out that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception, according to human tradition and the elemental powers of the world, and not according to Christ.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception, according to human tradition, according to the elemental principles of the world, and not according to Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves fullness, deity and bodily dwelling together.
key_decisions.before: For in him all the fullness of deity dwells bodily,
key_decisions.after: For in him all the fullness of deity dwells bodily,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For in him all the fullness of deity dwells bodily,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains circumcision and bodily stripping images without substituting a doctrinal paraphrase.
key_decisions.before: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made by hands, in the removal of the body of flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,
key_decisions.after: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not performed by hands, in the stripping off of the body of flesh, in Christ's circumcision.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: In him also you were circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the removal of the body of flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the documentary image, opposition and crucifixion action.
key_decisions.before: He erased the record of debt with its decrees that stood against us. He removed it from the way, nailing it to the cross.
key_decisions.after: He erased the written record against us, with its decrees that opposed us. He took it away, nailing it to the cross.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: having erased the record of debt that stood against us with its legal demands. This he set aside, nailing it to the cross.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the stripping and triumphal-procession images while leaving the final pronoun open.
key_decisions.before: He stripped the rulers and authorities and made a public example of them, triumphing over them in the cross.
key_decisions.after: He stripped the rulers and authorities and exposed them publicly, triumphing over them in it.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: He disarmed the rulers and authorities and made a public display of them, triumphing over them in it.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the pinned seen reading, judicial image and ironic false humility.
key_decisions.before: Do not let anyone disqualify you, delighting in self-abasement and worship of angels, dwelling on visions, puffed up without reason by a fleshly mind,
key_decisions.after: Do not let anyone disqualify you by delighting in humility and worship of angels, going on about what he has seen, puffed up without cause by his fleshly mind.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let no one disqualify you, insisting on humility and worship of angels, going on about visions, puffed up without reason by a fleshly mind,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps apparent wisdom, bodily severity and the difficult negative assessment.
key_decisions.before: Such practices have an appearance of wisdom in self-made religion, self-abasement, and severe treatment of the body, but they have no value in restraining fleshly indulgence.
key_decisions.after: Such practices have a reputation for wisdom in self-made religion, humility and harsh treatment of the body, but they are of no value against indulgence of the flesh.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: These have indeed an appearance of wisdom in self-made religion and humility and severe treatment of the body, but they are of no value against the indulgence of the flesh.
